title: Review design checks
description: Read what the design checks report for the training road and follow one to the setting it needs.

setup.goal: Read the review list and follow a check to its setting.
audience: Forest road designers new to PGMaps
access: None: the lesson opens the synthetic training project, which needs no sign-in and no data download.
setup.startingScreen: The road designer on the Hillside access training project, at station 0+000 with the cross-section shown.
limitations: The findings are those of the unedited training project; your own road will have its own.

overlay.title: Open Review
overlay.body: Open the Review tab. Its list reflects the open project and the active road.

overlay.title: Read the findings
overlay.body: Ready to review reports 3 outside a limit and 9 to do. Read the note under each: one flags the synthetic terrain, another that the fill is 17,580 m³ short with no borrow source set.

overlay.title: Follow a check to its setting
overlay.body: Under To do, find Design standards and select Set standards. The Design standards settings open.

overlay.title: Read the design limits
overlay.body: Grade limit (%) is 12 and Minimum radius (m) is 25. On a real job, check these against the job’s requirements before confirming them; here, leave them as they are.
